intro.title: Labs
intro.lead: The workshop. Free tools I build on weekends, live for anyone to use — and each one tells you plainly what it does with your data. Selected experiments from UtpalDasLabs.

tools.name: Leben in Deutschland
tools.tagline: All 460 official citizenship-test questions — swipe to study, in German and English.
tools.description: A flashcard app for the official German citizenship test: all 460 questions, the 300 general ones plus 10 for each of the 16 Bundesländer. Every card carries the German original, an English translation, a plain-English note on what it actually means for someone living here, and a visual. Tell it when your test is and it works out how many cards a day you need. Installs to your home screen, works offline, and your progress stays on your device — with a backup file you can export and import.
tools.coverCaption: swipe to study · offline · DE + EN

tools.name: B1-Trainer
tools.tagline: Everything the German B1 exam tests — vocabulary, grammar, and all four modules.
tools.description: A study app for Zertifikat Deutsch B1, covering Goethe, telc and DTZ — pick your certificate and the facts, timings and official links change to match. 931 words across 22 themes, 166 grammar drills with an explanation every time, and 31 full exam tasks across Lesen, Hören, Schreiben and Sprechen — 1,097 items on a spaced-repetition schedule. Hören is spoken aloud by your device rather than shipped as audio files, with the same play limit as the real exam. Lesen and Hören are scored against an answer key; Schreiben and Sprechen are not pretend-graded — you get the clock, the phrase bank, a model answer and the examiner's criteria as a checklist. Installs to your home screen, works offline, progress stays on your device.

tools.name: We the Future
tools.tagline: Public money, public proof — government projects checked against official records.
tools.description: A mobile-first app showing government projects near you, with map and list discovery, search, and filters for planned, ongoing, delayed, completed and finished early. Every project carries an evidence panel: official source links, source type, verification status, confidence, and when it was last verified. Verified facts and timelines are kept strictly separate from community ratings and reviews, so what the record says and what people say never blur together.

tools.name: Retailor
tools.tagline: Tailor your CV to any job with the AI you already use.
tools.description: Put your CV in, copy a ready-made prompt into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Perplexity along with the job advert, paste the reply back, review every suggested change side by side, and download a polished PDF. Runs entirely in your browser — no sign-up, no upload, no tracking.
tools.coverCaption: browser-only · bring your own AI · PDF out
